title: Muzi-产品精修4
description: 产品精修，物品抠图居中，置于纯净的白色背景上，3D渲染，精准还原产品颜色，增加科技感与高级感。极致展示材质质感（金属亮度质感,细节细腻层次感，光影层次感强）清除所有指纹，灰尘与瑕疵，让产品看起来洁净，崭新。光线均匀，无明显杂乱阴影，符合电商主图标准，主图突出
remark: 适合反光面的产品，如杯子，金属类的
notes: Product refinement, item cutout centered, placed on a pure white background, 3D rendering, precise restoration of product color, adding a sense of technology and sophistication. Ultimate display of material texture (metal brightness texture, delicate details, strong light and shadow layering) eliminates all fingerprints, dust, and defects, making the product look clean and brand new. The lighting is uniform, without obvious messy shadows, in line with the e-commerce main image standards, and the main image is prominent
